text:
maria-ops: kicking off edge-region bring-up for ap-east-edge1. primary goals: GPU pool provisioning (A100), local image mirror, GitOps/Helm pipeline validation, and handoff doc. will run preflight at 11:15 PT — ping if you see quota/network blockers.

devin-infra: started infra runbook: terraform apply for cluster + reserved node pool. hitting cloud quota check, requested +4 GPU quota in console. created helm app chart in repo infra/edge-ap-east. triggered CI job: edge-ap-east/deploy-pipeline -> will create namespace + flux sync.

sam-ml: re: artifacts — we need the quantized model images (8-bit) copied to regional registry before canary. copying from gcr-prod to regional mirror avoids egress but needs signed image replication. estimated extra image storage ~150GB (temp). cost FYI.

lee-oncall: please add canary policies and circuit-breaker to the Helm value overrides. if model pod OOM or kernel panic happens we should autoscale down and route to fallback region. add SLO alerts for p95 latency + GPU mem usage.

priya-sre: preflight checklist (quick):
- cloud quotas validated (GPUs, CPUs, IPs)
- VPC peering established to control plane and shared services
- NAT/egress policy for model pull restricted to mirror registry
- registry mirror seeded with model images + signatures
- GitOps flux installed with read-only deploy key
- Helm values set for nodeSelector: gpu=true and tolerations
- canary rollout configured with 5% traffic for 10m

priya-sre: replication command I'm using to seed the mirror (example):
```bash
skopeo sync --src docker --dest docker --all \ 
  docker://gcr.io/rw-models/quantized:v3 \ 
  docker://mirror-registry.ap-east-edge1.redwood-internal/models/quantized:v3
```

priya-sre: helm values override snippet to enable circuit-breaker + canary:```yaml
replicaCount: 2
resources:
  limits:
    nvidia.com/gpu: 1
canary:
  enabled: true
  trafficPercent: 5
circuitBreaker:
  enabled: true
  failureThreshold: 3
  retryDelay: 30s
```

devin-infra: flux sync job shows successful commit apply but imagePullBackOff on the model-deploy canary pod — looks like image wasn't replicated yet. I queued the skopeo job; will recheck in 4m.

deploy-bot: Deployment pipeline edge-ap-east/deploy-pipeline started by devops-ci at 2110004360. status: preflight checks running.

sam-ml: if image replication is slow we can temporarily point canary to the smaller evaluation image (cache layer) to validate routing + metrics before actual model starts. tradeoffs: not full perf, but validates SLO plumbing.

maria-ops: good call. set canary image to eval:v1 for now and re-run canary smoke. make sure to note in handoff doc that final rollout must wait for signed image replication.

priya-sre: smoke check commands after canary up:```bash
kubectl -n models rollout status deploy/model-deploy-canary
kubectl -n models get pods -l app=model-deploy -o wide
kubectl -n monitoring logs -l job=canary-prober --tail=50
```

devin-infra: after skopeo finished, skopeo exit 0 and registry shows image with matching digest. redeployed canary -> now ready. running perf probe. :white_check_mark:

lee-oncall: monitor p95 and GPU mem. alert if p95 > 450ms or GPU mem > 92%. I added temporary alerts to prometheus-rule edge-ap-east-canary.

maria-ops: perf probe reports p50 120ms p95 420ms on eval image; we'll rerun with quantized model once nightly registry sync finishes. next steps: update runbook with exact quota ticket id, add handoff note for oncall runbook, and schedule a 30m post-deploy review tomorrow 9am PT. tagging @devin-infra @priya-sre for handoff. :thumbsup:

devin-infra: noted. I updated the infrastructure runbook in docs/regions/ap-east-edge1.md with terraform state reference and the helm overrides used. leaving cluster in canary mode until post-deploy review.

priya-sre: leaving checklist entry 'handoff to oncall' with commands and rollback steps. rollback is simply flipping canary traffic to 0 and scaling down GPUs in helm values, then flux revert. snippet:```bash
fluxctl rollback --resource=Kustomization/edge-app --to-revision=HEAD~1
helm upgrade --install --values values-canary.yaml app ./chart --set canary.trafficPercent=0
```

lee-oncall: acknowledged. I'll be on pager for the next 24h and will escalate if we hit regional network flaps.

maria-ops: thanks team. closing thread after post-deploy review. will attach final handoff doc link here when done. :white_check_mark:
